description: This source file implements the RemindersService class, which provides functionalities to list and add reminders using EventKit. The class handles authorization checks, fetching reminders with filtering, and creating new reminders with optional due dates and notes.

classes.name: RemindersService
classes.description: A final class that conforms to RemindersServicing protocol, providing asynchronous methods to list and add reminders using EventKit.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Fetches reminders from the event store based on provided filtering parameters, returning a list of reminder payloads.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates a new reminder with specified parameters such as title, notes, due date, and list, saving it to the event store.
